A refined adult anime face drawn to her own FACE line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face. This crop wins over every other line: details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. Never widen the framing to show a hidden support, hand or leg; a limb crossing the edge runs naturally on past it, never cut off or fading out inside the image. Both shoulders and upper arms show and run on past the edge — never an armless torso.

SCREENS: any monitor, cabinet, handheld, box or poster shows only abstract colored light, simple shapes or blank art — no recognisable game, character, logo, title or interface, no readable text.

SCENE (chosen):

Outfit: an Arabian-nights look — a jewelled cropped top, a sheer veil scarf over the shoulders, low-slung flowing chiffon trousers and gold coin anklets; styled with delicate drop earrings

COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera at her eye level; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right index finger rests against her lips in a hush.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests low, below the frame edge — that arm runs down from her shoulder out of frame.

EXPRESSION: mouth open wide in a laugh with teeth showing and cheeks raised, eyes open and engaged with lids only slightly narrowed. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.

source_influence: balanced — her species shows as one accessory and one object in the scene; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face and hair — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; the part of that outfit inside the crop must read at first glance in its own colours. ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus; other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No Pokémon, animals or other creatures, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions — about 7.5 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. No extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.
